select t.id, t.user_id as userId, t.work_date as workDate, t.company_id as companyId, t.rest_schedule_id as restScheduleId, t.schedule_id as scheduleId, t.overtime_reason as overtimeReason, t.approval_people_id as approvalPeopleId, t.approval_status as approvalStatus from work_overtime_info t left join base_schedule bs on t.schedule_id=bs.id
t.approval_status = 1
and t.user_id in
#{item}
and DATE_FORMAT(t.work_date,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d')
order by bs.first_start_time asc

SELECT bs.* FROM base_schedule bs LEFT JOIN clinic_schedule cs ON cs.schedule_id = bs.id WHERE bs.type = '上班' and cs.clinic_id = #{companyId} and bs.first_start_time >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startTime},'%H:%i:%s') and IFNULL(bs.second_end_time,bs.first_end_time)<= DATE_FORMAT(#{endTime},'%H:%i:%s')

SELECT es.work_date FROM base_schedule bs LEFT JOIN employee_schedule es on es.schedule_id = bs.id WHERE bs.type = '休息' and es.employee_id = #{userId} and es.work_date >= #{startTime} and es.work_date <= #{endTime}

SELECT es.id scheduleId,es.clinic_id companyId,es.work_date,bs.first_start_time startTime,IFNULL(bs.second_end_time,bs.first_end_time) endTime,bs.name FROM base_schedule bs LEFT JOIN employee_schedule es on es.schedule_id = bs.id WHERE es.employee_id = #{userId} and es.work_date = #{workDate} and bs.type = '休息'
select count(*) from work_overtime_info where approval_status in (0,1) and rest_schedule_id = #{restScheduleId}
select count(*) from work_overtime_info where approval_status in (0,1) AND DATE_FORMAT(work_date,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(#{workDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') and user_id = #{userId}
